lines.text_source: Oh, I thought my little friend was inside that armour, but I must have gotten the wrong soldier. Speak with me if you feel like a challenge.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Ah, pensei que meu pequeno amigo estava dentro daquela armadura, mas acho que peguei o soldado errado. Fale comigo se quiser um desafio.
